([[Oakland, California]]) | college = [[Duke Blue Devils women's basketball|Duke]] (2013–2017) | draft_league = WNBA | draft_year = 2017 | draft_round = 3 | draft_pick = 31 | draft_team = [[Atlanta Dream]] | career_start = | career_end = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2013 McDonald's All-American Girls Game|2013]]) | wnba_profile = | medaltemplates = {{MedalCompetition|[[AfroBasket Women|AfroBasket]]}} {{MedalGold|[[2021 Women's Afrobasket|2021 Cameroon]]|}} {{MedalSport | Women's [[basketball]] }} {{MedalCountry | the {{USA}} }} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Under-17 Women's Basketball World Cup|FIBA Under-17 World Cup]]}} {{Medal|Gold|[[2012 FIBA Under-17 World Championship for Women|2012 Netherlands]]|[[United States women's national under-17 basketball team|Team]]}} }} '''Oderah Obiageli Chidom''' (born 9 July 1995) is a Nigerian-American professional [[basketball]] player who plays for the [[Nigeria women's national basketball team|Nigeria women's national team]]. Chidom has two younger siblings: a brother, Arinze, and a sister, Amara. She went to Bishop O’Dowd High School in Oakland, California, where she played on their Varsity Women's basketball team. She played for [[Duke University]].{{Cite web|title=Oderah Chidom - 2016-17 - Women's Basketball|url=https://goduke.com/sports/womens-basketball/roster/oderah-chidom/2574|access-date=2021-07-16|website=Duke University|language=en}} She was drafted by the [[Atlanta Dream]].{{cite web |last1=Brown |first1=Chris |title=Blue Devil Selected in WNBA Draft |url=https://balldurham.com/2017/04/14/blue-devil-selected-wnba-draft/ |website=Ball Durham |access-date=16 July 2021 |date=14 April 2017 |archive-date=16 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210716204319/https://balldurham.com/2017/04/14/blue-devil-selected-wnba-draft/ |url-status=dead }}{{Cite web|title=Oderah Chidom|url=https://stats.wnba.com/player/1628266/career/|access-date=2021-07-16|website=WNBA Stats|language=en}} She played for the Tsmoki-Minsk.{{Cite web|title=Oderah Obiageli CHIDOM at the EuroCup Women 2019-20|url=http://www.fiba.basketball/eurocupwomen/19-20/player/Oderah-Obiageli-Chidom|access-date=2021-07-16|website=FIBA.basketball|language=en}} She signed to play for Angers.{{Cite web|last=Eurobasket|title=Oderah Chidom Player Profile, Angers - Union Feminine Basket 49, News, Stats - Eurobasket|url=https://www.eurobasket.com/index.aspx|access-date=2021-07-16|website=Eurobasket LLC}} She participated at the U17 Women's Basketball Championship. She participated at 2019 EuroCup Women.
